description: Variation of conditions of approved permission 4309/19 (as amended by 4309/19/02, 4309/19/28, 4309/19/31, 4309/19/33): Approved plans (Condition 2),  Phasing Plan (Condition 3), Construction Management & Logistics Plan (Condition 4), Demolition & Construction Environmental Management Plan (Condition 5), CHSEP (Condition 6), Land Contamination (Condition 7), Long Term Monitoring (Condition 8), UXO Risk Assessment (Condition 9), Piling/boreholes (Condition 10), Foundation Works Risk Assessment (Condition 11), Tree Protection (Condition 12), Habitat Creation Management Plan (Condition 13), Circular Economy (Condition 14), Materials Management Plan (Condition 15), Asbestos (Condition 16), Petrol Filling Station (Condition 17), Railway Vibration (Condition 18), Fire Safety (Condition 19), Re-radiated noise (Condition 20), Facing Materials (Condition 21), Decommission of investigative boreholes (Condition 23), Cycle Parking provision (Condition 25), ESVP (Condition 26), Wildlife Housing (Condition 29), Bird Management (Condition 30), Walls and Fences (Condition 31), Security (Condition 32), Wheelchair dwellings (Condition 33), Balconies & Roof Gardens (Condition 36), Mechanical Ventilation (Condition 37), Design Quality (Condition 38), CO2 reduction (Condition 41), Delivery & Service Management Plan (Condition 43), Waste Management (Condition 44), Car Park Management Plan (Condition 46), External Lighting (Condition 48), Children’s Play (Condition 49), BREEAM (Condition 65), Bicycle Spaces - Residential (Condition 69), Bicycle Spaces - Commercial (Condition 71), Air Quality Positive Statement (Condition 82), Whole Life Carbon (Condition 83); Digital Connectivity (Condition 84) and Quantum (Condition 88).  And removal of conditions: Final School Travel Plan (Condition 53), Ventilation/ Filtration/ Extraction (Condition 57), Bicycle Spaces – School (Condition 70) and School Layout (Condition 87): Change to approved design, scale and uses including removal of school.  (summary).  The development is subject to an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)
